# @istarry/dsh-edit-regen

Standalone session-side verbs for the edit-and-regenerate surface: authorized file-attachment reads, the rewrite fork-boundary lookup, and durable session-shell cleanup

本包是 [dsh-agent-suite](https://github.com/iStarryDust/dsh-agent-suite) 的组成部分，由父包 `@istarry/dsh-agent-suite` 依赖引入，通常不需要单独安装。

许可：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
